text:
Maya (CSM): FYI — Skylark's contract hits EoT next month. They verbally committed to continue but procurement needs a revised SOW + PO flow. Need to lock terms by Mon.
Jordan (Account Exec): What's the ask on pricing? last year was 24k/yr for standard support.
Maya (CSM): They asked for a 12mo commit with a usage buffer, proposing 10% loyalty credit if we keep pricing flat. Legal flagged an amendment for the SOW to include GDPR addendum.
Leo (Procurement - Skylark Inc): @Maya can you share the exact contract/line items? Procurement requires: PO, signed amendment, and net30 billing. Also we need vendor setup form.
Maya (CSM): Attaching the proposed amendment draft here — short SOW change + data processing addendum.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Quick note: if they want an additional embed quota, we need to add a metered line item, otherwise we'll have throttling problems. Sam can confirm numbers.
Jordan (Account Exec): We can add a "burst quota" as an optional addendum at $X per 100k tokens. I'll add that to the quote.
Priya (Finance): Workflow: once PO is received we can set invoice terms to net30 and apply the 10% credit as a one-time invoice adjustment. Need billing_email and legal entity name.
Maya (CSM): Billing contact from Skylark is ap@skylark.co and legal entity "Skylark Incorporated" per their procurement form.
Leo (Procurement - Skylark Inc): Confirmed. We'll prepare the PO once amendment is signed. Do you accept DocuSign?
docusign-bot: New envelope created: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/0a1b2c — awaiting signatures (Maya, Skylark Legal).
Maya (CSM): Signing now :thumbsup:
Jordan (Account Exec): @Priya once signed can you generate a pro-forma invoice so procurement can attach to the PO? They asked for attachment before issuance.
Priya (Finance): Yep — will generate pro-forma immediately after DocuSign completes. I need the final line items (Jordan) and the order number (Leo).
Leo (Procurement - Skylark Inc): Order number will be SK-2026-0456. Expect PO within 48 hours after pro-forma.
Sam (Solutions Eng): FYI if they sign the amendment today we'll push the extra quota live by EOD tomorrow. No infra changes needed.
Maya (CSM): Great — timeline aligns. I'll monitor docusign-bot and chase Skylark Legal if not signed by EOD.
Jordan (Account Exec): Heads-up: if procurement counters on term length (prefers 6mo), we should push for 12mo plus a mid-term review. I'll prep messaging.
Leo (Procurement - Skylark Inc): We prefer 12mo but need flexibility for a Q3 headcount freeze — would you accept a 60% guaranteed minimum for months 7-12?
Jordan (Account Exec): We can do a guaranteed minimum clause — will draft language: "Months 7–12 guaranteed minimum = 60% of committed units; overages billed monthly."
Maya (CSM): Noted. I'll capture feedback in the renewal tracker and update the customer health notes.
Priya (Finance): Once PO arrives, email invoices@redwood.ai with PO attached and reference SK-2026-0456.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team. I'll post a short summary after signature. /remind @Leo to upload PO in 3 days if not received.
Leo (Procurement - Skylark Inc): Will do. Thanks everyone
